n = int(input())
b = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
count = 0
sum_ = 0
odd = 0
even = 0
al = []

for i in range(n):
    if a[i] % 2 != 0:
        odd += 1
    else:
        even += 1
    if i != n - 1:
        if odd == even:
            al.append(abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]))

al.sort()
for value in al:
    sum_ += value
    if sum_ <= b:
        count += 1
    else:
        break

print(count)
